_about: Reproducibility repeats (prepared, not started): per repeat, the original's per-opponent match id, seed and seats, game dice, option-order seed, prompt, rules and settings, its coverage, today's blockers, the paid gates, cost basis, GPU plan and start commands. Written by tools/v3/repeats/repeats.py manifest from v3.db (read-only).

seed_mechanism.finding: The league runner has no per-match or per-pair seed field in its league config. A new pair's seed and seats come from the two player names and the rules hash (Rules::pair_seed, Rules::sides; seed_rule pair-v1), so a renamed repeat would get other dice; the original late entries' seeds are exactly pair_seed of their names (checked for #780, #807, #818, #845, #867, #905, #920), Liquid d1-ultra's League 1 seeds are not (older rule). One existing path replays a given seed: league::derive_fixture takes a pair's seed and first player from its valid match or, without one, from its last voided match ('a voided pair replays with the same dice'), and every game's dice follow from the match seed (dice::round_seed) and every option order from the option-order seed and the position (players::order::option_order), never from names. The standalone `jevgammon match --seed --order-seed` takes a seed but not a player's settings, stage or league, so it is not the same protocol.
seed_mechanism.no_code_route: repeats.py pin ID --apply (needs approval; writes v3.db, changes no existing row): the repeat's players row (the settings below) and, per pair, one placeholder match with valid 0, status 'aborted', stage 'late-entry', no games, void_reason naming the original match, its seed and its seats; the original runner builds then replay those seeds unchanged. Nothing on the site reads aborted voided rows (cup.compute and the matches pages take finished matches).
seed_mechanism.smallest_runner_change: League config field `pinned_pairs` [{opponent, seed, first}] for the only_pairs_of setup, stored in a new leagues column (so --resume and league-add keep it) and read by derive_fixture before Rules::pair_seed; with a test: about 40 lines in league.rs, db.rs and migrate.rs. Not made (Zeki #4667: ask first); it would also mean a new runner build instead of each original's.
